subject: Regional outage — EU & APAC availability diversion and next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <ops@aurelia-health.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Aug 2029 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Regional availability impact — immediate diversion guidance (EU & APAC)

Hi Maya,

We observed a regional control-plane degradation in our EU class of seats beginning ~07:50 UTC that is affecting inference provisioning for EU-hosted endpoints and causing elevated error rates and latency for some customers. We've traced the trigger to a third-party cloud peering disruption; RegionCloud is still investigating.

Immediate actions we've executed on our side:
- Activated automated failover to compatible model variants in the WAN-adjacent pools (these reduce capacity but keep existing sessions alive where possible).
- Turned on prefix KV-caching for long-running chat sessions to reduce token generation demand.
- Opened temporary routing to our US-dedicated clusters for EU traffic; this adds ~120–220ms RTT for some call paths.

What we recommend for Aurelia Health (short-term, required to maintain availability):
1) Switch your API endpoint preference to the regional-agnostic host we provided (api.redwood.ai/bridge) — this endpoint will route to the nearest available capacity and prefers US fallback for EU-origin traffic.
2) If your client enforces geo-restrictions, add the allow-list entry `34.120.18.0/24` to permit cross-region fallback.
3) For high-priority interactive flows, reduce max_tokens to 512 and enable streaming to mitigate tail latency.

I've attached a small config snippet (eu-fallback-config.json) and a 2-page checklist (traffic-diversion-checklist.pdf) with step-by-step instructions.

We will keep you updated every ~30–60 minutes until RegionCloud confirms full restoration. If you'd like, we can schedule a short bridge with your ops team now to walk through the routing change.

Apologies for the disruption — I'm on this and will escalate if the third-party root cause persists.

Regards,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0148

---
Attachments: eu-fallback-config.json (text/json), traffic-diversion-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Update: EU/APAC availability — actions completed and next steps

Hi Maya / Aurelia ops team,

Quick update following our bridge and triage: thanks for joining. Summary of what we did and what to expect next:

Completed actions (Redwood):
- Confirmed model warm-up on US fallback clusters for m-instruct-7b and m-chat-13b. Verified successful handshake and sanity generation for your dev key.
- Applied the allow-list IP block you requested; confirmed egress pairs for your VPC with your networking team.
- Enabled streaming and lowered default max_tokens for your production project as a protective setting (you can revert after stability).

Customer-visible impact now:
- Error rates have dropped from ~12% to ~1.5% for rerouted calls; tail latency for affected flows is ~180ms higher on average versus baseline.
- Two near-term actions for you:
  1) Keep the bridge endpoint in your client for the next 6–12 hours and monitor for 503s.
  2) If you observe sustained higher latency on billing-summary flows, toggle the light-weight rerank mode (docs link below) to keep p95 within your threshold.

RegionCloud status: Jules reports partial peering restoration for EU-west at 09:30 UTC and continued mitigation for other zones. They estimate a rolling full recovery window of 2–6 hours but cautioned about regressions during the repair window.

Follow-ups we will send:
- Formal incident summary and a postmortem (INC-2029-08-20-AU-bridge) within 72 hours including root cause, timeline, and long-term mitigations.
- A proposed credit calculation if the outage exceeds our SLA thresholds — Neha will draft the template.

Attachments included: eu-fallback-config.json (configuration snippet), traffic-diversion-checklist.pdf (what we changed client-side).

If you want a technical write-up now, I can share the quick triage notes and telemetry graphs.

Connor O'Brien
